result.summary: This PR fixes an off-by-one bug in contrib/seeds/makeseeds.py's parseline() function: the length check required only 11 fields but the code reads the 12th field (index 11) for the user agent, so an 11-field line raised an uncaught IndexError and aborted the whole run. The fix changes the check to require 12 fields so such lines are skipped as originally intended. A first commit adds characterization/regression unit tests documenting both the old crashing behavior and the fixed skip behavior.
result.problem: Operators running makeseeds.py to regenerate the DNS seed list can hit a crash mid-run when the input file (often built by concatenating two crawlers' outputs, per the description) contains a line with exactly 11 whitespace-separated fields, aborting the whole seed generation after the asmap database is already loaded.

open_concerns: Whether the newly added unit tests are worth keeping for a script achow101 says is run by very few people; author has offered to remove them if preferred, no final decision yet.
resolved_concerns: l0rinc's suggestion to restructure into a characterization-then-fix commit pair, implemented by the author and ACKed.

result.card: This PR fixes an off-by-one bug in contrib/seeds/makeseeds.py where parseline() checked for at least 11 fields but read a 12th field, causing an uncaught IndexError that aborted seed-generation runs on certain truncated lines. It affects seed operators, a small population per maintainer achow101 ('run by a number of people that is countable on one hand'), but the crash itself is real and the fix is a straightforward one-line correction with added regression tests. l0rinc ACKed the final commit after the author restructured it into a characterization-then-fix pair; achow101 questions the value of the added tests but raises no objection to the fix, and the author has offered to drop the tests if preferred. Review of the core fix is ready; the only lingering item is a minor, non-blocking decision about test inclusion. No dependencies on other PRs.
